related.title: HTTP/3：串流內缺口與跨串流交付
related.titleEn: HTTP/3: within-stream gaps and cross-stream delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受205/285 ms未退避PTO；連續PTO的指數退避須另列。 交接時須能核對：交付 pto-ledger.csv、三個space分類與探測／遺失事件區分。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept205/285 ms before backoff; repeated-PTO exponential backoff is recorded separately. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver pto-ledger.csv, three-space classification and separate probe/loss events.
related.difference: 為每串流分別保存已收區間與可交付前綴，不共用單一連線offset。
related.differenceEn: Track received intervals and deliverable prefixes per stream rather than one connection offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
QUIC PTO包含平滑RTT、變異及適用的max_ack_delay；觸發探測不代表所有未確認封包都遺失。
教學基準：100+max(4*20,1)+25 = 205 ms；對照：100+max(4*40,1)+25 = 285 ms。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

HTTP/3利用QUIC獨立串流減少傳輸層跨串流阻塞；同一串流仍需有序資料且QPACK可另造成相依。
教學基準：1000+4000 = 5000 deliverable B；對照：5000+4000 = 9000 deliverable B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
QUIC PTO combines smoothed RTT, variation and applicable max_ack_delay; probing does not mark all outstanding packets lost.
Teaching baseline: 100+max(4*20,1)+25 = 205 ms; comparison: 100+max(4*40,1)+25 = 285 ms. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

HTTP/3 uses independent QUIC streams to reduce transport cross-stream blocking; each stream remains ordered and QPACK can create separate dependencies.
Teaching baseline: 1000+4000 = 5000 deliverable B; comparison: 5000+4000 = 9000 deliverable B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: RESTCONF: ETag concurrency and lost updates

related.difference: 以resource、read ETag、write If-Match、current ETag與status建立交易表。
related.differenceEn: Record resource, read ETag, write If-Match, current ETag and response status for each transaction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

RESTCONF可使用HTTP條件請求避免覆蓋已改變資料；讀取與寫入之間的版本必須匹配。
教學基準：8/50*100 = 16 %；對照：2/50*100 = 4 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RESTCONF uses HTTP conditional requests to avoid overwriting changed data; read/write versions must match.
Teaching baseline: 8/50*100 = 16 %; comparison: 2/50*100 = 4 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
